confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Amman pricing; no live listings were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain, and hotel anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the local beer price using a typical bar markup, since direct knowledge is weak. Alcohol prices vary a lot by venue type (licensed hotel bar vs. local restaurant). The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Middle East basis: priced against mid-range Levant and North African capitals with similar tourist accommodation supply, adjusted for Amman's relatively high hotel costs and limited alcohol availability.
